title: abi/screenshot-to-code: turn interface images into editable web code
friendlyTitle: screenshot-to-code turns a picture into website code
summary: This popular open-source project converts screenshots, mockups and videos into implementations using HTML, Tailwind, React or Vue, with support for multiple model providers. Its workflow is aimed at quickly recreating a visual starting point rather than replacing review of accessibility, behaviour and maintainability.
friendlySummary: Give this open-source tool a screenshot or design, and it can create editable HTML, React or Vue code that looks similar.
whyItMatters: Designers and developers can use it to prototype an interface or recover a code baseline from an existing visual. Treat the generated output as a draft, then check responsive layout, semantics, licensing and production quality.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can save time when starting a web page. You should still check the code, accessibility and phone layout before using it.
